scope: Unchanged released decoders (decodeFullAnnotator) of a transaction body, witness set or whole transaction of each era from Shelley to Conway at the era's decoder version (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9), each holding a RecD record a block can hold written as a definite and an indefinite list: the update proposal (Shelley to Babbage), the execution units of a redeemer (Alonzo to Conway, list and map forms, at and over their bounds), Conway's GovActionId (at and over the bound of its index), VotingProcedure, ProposalProcedure, Constitution and Anchor, the MaryValue of an output and a collateral return (Mary to Conway), and the list form of auxiliary data in a transaction (Allegra to Conway), with the value and the auxiliary data list also refused before their fields (an indefinite list with a field of the wrong type, a definite list of three); no ledger rule, signature or script is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded ledger package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

coders.note: decodeCount (RecD cn) n reads the length around a decoder that reads nothing (482)

shelleyPParams.note: DecCBOR (Update era): RecD with no version guard (267)

exUnits.note: DecCBOR ExUnits: RecD below decoder version 12, each unit a Word64 at most maxBound :: Int64 (195-215)

alonzoTxWits.note: RedeemersRaw: decodeElement and decodeMapRedeemers read the units with decCBOR (550-597)

procedures.note: GovActionIx a Word16 (162); GovActionId (182-190), VotingProcedure (456-466), ProposalProcedure (522-533), Constitution (985-995): RecD below decoder version 12; decodeGovAction (880-895)

baseTypes.note: DecCBOR Anchor: RecD below decoder version 12 (996-1004)

maryValue.note: decodeMaryValue takes an indefinite list into decodeValuePair, a RecD record below decoder version 12 (287-311); equal to the released cardano-ledger-mary 1.11.0.0

allegraTxAuxData.note: AllegraTxAuxDataRaw: the list form is a RecD record (185-210); equal to the released cardano-ledger-allegra 1.10.1.0

alonzoTxAuxData.note: decodeTxAuxDataByTokenType picks decodeAllegra, a RecD record below decoder version 12, for a definite or indefinite list (245-251, 302-312); equal to the released cardano-ledger-alonzo 1.16.0.0

sourceArchive.kind: repository tarball at the pinned commit

harness.image: scarab-conway-decoding:local (run as scarab-668-conway-decoding:local), from scripts/oracle/conway-decoding/Dockerfile on scarab-plutus176-context-reference:local
harness.change: the only change is the transaction kind for Allegra, Mary, Alonzo and Babbage (decodeFullAnnotator of Tx TopTx at the era's decoder version), which only Conway had; the 68 earlier lines were regenerated byte for byte with it
